key_highlights: ASX logged its third consecutive week of gains, propelled by robust rallies in materials and technology sectors.
Australian unemployment surged to a five-year high, shocking markets and heavily tempering RBA rate hike expectations.
The Australian dollar (AUD/USD) faced immediate downward pressure following the labour market deterioration.
Residential property market indicators deteriorated rapidly, with Sydney auction markets signaling heightened stress.

sectors.trend: Outperforming with strong exploration results across gold and rare earths, powering broad index gains.
sectors.implications: Gold producers and critical mineral developers remain attractive hedges, though China industrial risks require selective positioning.

sectors.trend: Elevated downside risk as five-year high unemployment and falling auction clearance rates threaten credit quality.
sectors.implications: Major retail lenders face net interest margin compression and rising loan loss provisioning as RBA rate hike odds recede.

sectors.trend: Sustained rally tracking global risk appetite and aided by softening domestic bond yield pressures.
sectors.implications: Multiples expansion supported by terminal rate repricing, but high-valuation names remain vulnerable to volatility.

sectors.trend: Supply-demand imbalances in domestic gas markets and rising legal/regulatory scrutiny over net-zero transitions.
sectors.implications: Domestic gas producers face ongoing policy interventions, while clean energy transition costs weigh on traditional utilities.

sectors.trend: Mounting headwinds from weak consumer sentiment, rising unemployment, and corporate governance controversies.
sectors.implications: Household spending contraction poses risks to mid-tier retail earnings; corporate scrutiny impacts sentiment.

key_themes: Labour market weakness easing RBA monetary policy pressure
Currency depreciation supporting Australian export competitiveness
Bifurcation between resilient resource exporters and weakening domestic credit/housing

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Labour Market Deterioration & Domestic Recession Risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive dividend payers and global healthcare exporters over cyclical domestic equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Residential Housing Market Correction & Bad Debts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic mortgage-concentrated banking majors; hedge bank exposures.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Trade Tensions & China Industrial Deflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritise low-cost, tier-one bulk commodity and precious metals producers with robust balance sheets.
Incorporate stringent ESG and governance filters to avoid idiosyncratic executive and cyber risks.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Diversified Resource Exporters
opportunities.rationale: Producers benefit from high commodity prices, production acceleration, and weaker AUD/USD tailwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Allocation to Quality Growth & Tech
opportunities.rationale: Repricing of RBA rate path limits further valuation compression for leading software/tech names.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Spiking unemployment and auction market slump elevate residential mortgage stress and margin contraction.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement Downside Index Protection on ASX 200
defensive_moves.rationale: Lock in gains after a three-week rally against domestic macroeconomic vulnerability and currency volatility.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 (^AXJO) consolidation as commodity and tech strength offsets deteriorating labour and credit metrics.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive outlook driven by potential RBA easing cycle in 2027, offset by global trade realignments.
key_catalysts: RBA Board meeting minutes and cash rate guidance
Quarterly bank trading updates and bad debt provisions
Commodity price trends across iron ore, gold, and thermal/metallurgical coal
watch_list: Sydney and Melbourne property auction clearance rates
China economic activity and manufacturing import demand
